Audiologist: A university graduate who has completed an approved graduate diploma (if graduated before May 1999) or masters degree (if graduated from May 1999) in audiology, eligible for membership of the Audiological Society of Australia.
Dietitian: A person eligible for full membership of the Dietitians Association of Australia.
FFPPOA: The beginning of the first full pay period commencing on or after a particular date.
Higher Qualifications Allowances: Allowances prescribed by salary, which count for all purposes of this Agreement.
HSR: Health and safety representative (including a deputy health and safety representative).
Medical Physicist: A person eligible for membership of the Australian College of Physical Scientists and Engineers in Medicine as a medical physicist.
NES: National Employment Standards as set out in the Fair Work Act 2009.
Pharmacist: A person registered under the Health Practitioner Regulation National Law Act whose name appears on the register of the Pharmacy Board of Australia.
Pharmacist Intern: A person who has completed a Bachelor of Pharmacy and is undergoing the practical training prescribed by the Pharmacy Board, prior to registration as a Pharmacist. Also referred to as a Trainee Pharmacist.
Psychologist: A person registered as a Psychologist by the Australian Health Practitioner Agency in partnership with the Psychology Board of Australia, including psychologists with provisional registration.
Recognised Prior Service: Service with another listed employer or related institution prior to the Employee's employment with the current Employer, where the gap between engagements is less than 3 months.
Scientist: A person holding a Bachelor of Applied Science, Bachelor of Science or equivalent; a postgraduate degree in science or applied science; or the relevant professional membership qualifications in their scientific discipline.
Service: Has the same meaning as 'service' and 'continuous service' under section 22 of the Fair Work Act 2009, and also includes Recognised Prior Service.
SHPA: Society of Hospital Pharmacists of Australia.
Shiftworker: For NES purposes, an Employee who works more than four ordinary hours on 10 or more weekends during the year in which annual leave accrues.
Student Pharmacist: A person undertaking a Bachelor of Pharmacy course who has not completed the Pharmacy III examinations.
Trainee Scientist: Any Employee engaged in studies leading to the attainment of the qualification Bachelor of Applied Science (Laboratory Medicine) or equivalent.
VHIA: Victorian Hospitals' Industrial Association — the employers' representative body.
Week: For the purposes of this Agreement, a week commences at midnight on a Sunday.
